The '''canyon krayt dragon''' was the smallest variant of the reptilian [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragons]] native to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], that came in two distinct variations. [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt]] kept a canyon krayt as a pet.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Canyon_krayt.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Profile of a canyon krayt.]]
The canyon krayt was a common species of krayt dragon that lived in the rocky caves and canyons of Tatooine's desert ranges. At ten meters in height and thirty meters in length, the canyon krayt represented the smaller of the krayt species.



An evolved hunter, the four-legged canyon krayt possessed a yellow-brown camouflage skin pattern, a five-horned crown ridge and a spike-studded tail. They usually fed on [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]], [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]], and lone [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]]. Though it was not nearly as big as the [[Greater krayt dragon/Legends|greater krayt]], it was big enough to cause destruction, yet small enough for a single [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] and his bantha to hunt down and kill. Like typical krayt dragons, they produced [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|pearls]], although the canyon krayt variety were typically a deep crimson color. Crimson pearls were quite valuable, often fetching upwards of one million credits each.

===Red variant===
[[File:Gkrayt_vs_Ckrayt-UA.jpg|thumb|200px|A rare red-skinned canyon krayt battles a [[Greater krayt dragon/Legends|greater krayt]].]]
There existed a variant of the canyon krayt that differed so much in appearance from the common canyon krayt to the point of appearing to be a different species altogether. The variant had a trio of large horns on its head that were apparently used for its own defense against such predators, such as the greater krayt dragon, as well as a tall, spined dorsal ridge running along its back. While this subspecies appeared to grow to sizes close to that of the canyon krayt, it was not as elongated, and instead featured a bulkier and more compact body. The variant species possessed large teeth and a powerful-looking jaw, as well as sharp claws that were likely used to take down prey such as [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]] and banthas. Its reddish coloration may have helped it to blend in with its surroundings.<ref name="UltAdv" />
